  • Prime Plot Geometry: Plot R5-180 boasts an ideal rectangular aspect ratio (10m frontage × ~18m depth = 1:1.795), which maximizes architectural floor plan efficiency and eliminates structural wastage.
  • Supremely Auspicious Vastu Alignment: West-facing frontage ruled by Lord Varuna and Lord Saturn, featuring golden entrance Padas 3 & 4 (Sugriva & Pushpadanta), brings profound financial compounding, high status, and fame.
  • Flawless Numerological Resonance: Rare mathematical synchronicity where plot area (179.54 sq.m. → Root 8 Saturn) perfectly mirrors the West direction's planetary ruler (Saturn), activating classical Sthira Sampatti yoga.
  • Perimeter Privacy & Green Buffer: Situated along the southern edge of Sector R5, the plot's rear abuts natural greenery, offering superior ventilation, sunlight, and quietude without rear bungalow obstruction.
  • Confirming Parties Title Safeguard: The actual 75-page Agreement to Sell binds all branches of the Shedge family as Party of the Third Part, legally barring ancestral claims against Plot R5-180.
Risks & Vulnerabilities (Cons)
  • Heavy Institutional Mortgage Exposure: Plot R5-180 is blanket-mortgaged under a ₹280 Crore master debenture facility with Vistra ITCL (India) Limited. Unconditional NOC is mandatory.
  • Aggressive Agreement Deviations: The 22-page Deviation Report strips buyers of plot sub-division rights (Cl 6.8) and vests overall township amenities solely in the promoter with commercial transfer rights (Cl 8.5).
  • Long Completion Horizon (May 2030): The proposed completion date is registered as 31-May-2030 (nearly 4 years from now), meaning final civic handover and township integration may take time.
  • Builder-Biased Termination Terms: Clause 21 allows builder to terminate on 15-day notice and refund buyer deposits without interest within 30 days while retaining rights to resell the plot during disputes.
  • Disclaimed Defect Liability: The builder marked "Defect Liability" as Not Applicable in their filing, despite RERA Sec 14(3) requiring 5-year structural defect warranty for roads, stormwater, and utilities.
  • Township Maintenance Dependency: Ongoing dependency on the master Township Management Association (TMA) for common utilities, water filtration, and security on a per sq.m. monthly charge.

5.3 Plotted Layout Revenue Law: Why Individual Plots DO NOT Appear on 7/12 & How to Check Actual Sales

A critical due diligence question for any land buyer is: "Why doesn't the 7/12 extract show individual plot numbers like R5-180, and can the builder conceal actual plot sales?"

1. 7/12 Tracks Parent Land, Not Sub-Plots
Revenue Rule
Under the Maharashtra Land Revenue Code (MLRC), 1966, a 7/12 extract records village revenue survey numbers. Individual layout plots (e.g., Plot R5-1 to R5-231) are sanctioned internally by PMRDA. Separate individual 7/12 extracts or Property Cards (मिळकत पत्रिका) are only generated AFTER project completion, handover of layout roads/amenity spaces to PMRDA, and final sub-division measurement (पोटहिस्सा मोजणी) by the DILR.
2. Actual Sales Are Recorded via IGR (Index-II)
Legal Registry
While builders may delay quarterly sales updates on MahaRERA, they cannot conceal registered transactions. Every legal sale, mortgage, or allotment of a plot must be registered at the Sub-Registrar Office (दुय्यम निबंधक कार्यालय), creating a registered Index-II (सूची क्र. २) searchable on the public IGR portal (freesearchigrservice.maharashtra.gov.in).
Buyer Protection Protocol: Verifying Unsold Status of Plot R5-180
Actionable Rule
1. Run IGR Index-II Search: Conduct an official search for Village Bhugaon, Survey 154, Keyword: "R5-180" for the years 2023–2026 to ensure zero prior registered sale deeds or agreements.
2. Warranty Clause in Allotment Letter: Require promoter to warrant that: "Plot R5-180 is unencumbered, not pledged, and has not been allotted, booked, or promised to any third party."
3. Immediate Sub-Registrar Registration: Under Section 47 of the Indian Registration Act, a registered agreement legally defeats any prior unregistered receipt or token.

7 Agreement for Sale & 22-Page Deviation Report Analysis

🔍

Promoter's Deviations from MahaRERA Model Form (Annexure A to Rule 8)

The promoter officially filed a 22-page Deviation Report explaining modifications made to the standard MahaRERA Model Agreement. Below is the legal audit of critical clauses affecting Plot R5-180:

Clause 6.8: Prohibition of Plot Sub-Division / Amalgamation
High Impact
Promoter's Clause: The allottee is strictly prohibited from subdividing Plot R5-180 or amalgamating it with adjacent plots, even if municipal development control rules permit such subdivision in the future.
Buyer Impact: Protects overall township density, but limits future commercial flexibility for heirs. Acceptable for single-family bungalow use.
Clause 8.5: Retention of Township Amenities & Commercial Exploitation
High Impact
Promoter's Clause: All master township clubhouses, equestrian facilities, sports complexes, and commercial zones remain the sole private property of the promoter. Plot buyers only receive non-exclusive, fee-based licensee access.
Buyer Impact: Allottees do NOT acquire undivided ownership in master clubhouses. Maintenance fees and usage tariffs remain promoter-regulated.
Clause 21: Promoter's Asymmetric Termination Rights
Moderate Risk
Promoter's Clause: If the buyer defaults on installments, promoter may terminate upon 15-day notice, deduct earnest money (up to 10%), and refund balance within 30 days without interest, retaining rights to resell immediately.
Negotiation Recommendation: Demand reciprocal cure period (minimum 30 days) and tie promoter delay default to standard SBI MCLR + 2% interest under RERA Rule 18.
Defect Liability Period Disclaimer
Legal Deviation
Promoter's Filing: Marked "Defect Liability" as Not Applicable for plotted layouts.
Statutory Override: RERA Section 14(3) applies mandatorily. Promoter remains liable for 5 years for structural defects in common layout infrastructure (roads, drains, water lines).

Mandate Full Execution by Shedge Confirming Parties
